notes: Verified live 2026-10-07 from a residential connection in headed Chrome, read only. The results URL /search/genealogy/results?first=&last= works directly and lists 10 cards per page for John Smith (248 records) in #summaryResults, each with a name heading (h2.seo-heading) and a nested table with Born (or Birth), Age, Lives in, Lived and Related rows. The card's own links go to a session bound /search/people/results?...&rid=... URL, so the stable record identity is the data-perma-link attribute (/record/<id>), which stays the same across loads. That perma link answers 404 when opened directly, so it is an identity for matching, not a page to visit. Age and locations are read by row position (third row, fourth and fifth rows) because the rows carry no classes. The opt-out page itself answers with a Cloudflare Turnstile interstitial from this machine, so the remove recipe stays unverified. The next version replaces the home page form with the direct results URL and real card selectors; the old version matched every list item and returned the same "People Records" heading for each result.
